texts390.text: A quiet resting place for your tokens. Lay them to rest. Wake up with WAKE.
Some things are ready to be laid to rest.
Connect to find your eligible token balances.
The cemetery is awaiting its owner’s WAKE setup.
Every token has a story. This is where it rests.
The first burial will place a tombstone here.
Trade WAKE in its deployed IMD pool. Use WAKE to leave flowers, or keep it as a memory.
A quote includes the pool fee. Gas is paid separately in ETH. USD prices are unavailable.
Maximum difference from the quote. Choose 0.01% to 5%.
A proper goodbye, in four steps.
Connect your wallet. We check every consecrated token for an eligible balance.
Approve the full balance, then bury it. This is permanent, once per wallet per token.
Receive 0.05% of the remaining vault per burial. Earlier burials receive more.
The first mourner writes the epitaph. Anyone can burn WAKE to leave flowers.
A little closure for the things we held.
Built for the tokens that didn’t make it. No ETH is accepted by the cemetery.
